object_reference.local_id: unsigned BIGINT; canonical decimal string at API boundary
object_reference.display_label: snapshot only; never join on label

money_and_points.account_unit_scale: 0..4 fixed on account creation; versioned conversion required for change

intent.conflict: canonical semantic fingerprint mismatch is CONFLICT; actor/permissions rechecked before replay

projection.permission: purpose is not an authorization token; current scope enforced

snapshot.watermark: explicit source set or reliable snapshot token; never MAX(id) as commit guarantee

read_rules.substring_search: not promised indexed; choose a reviewed dedicated search implementation if needed

timestamp.ui: render school IANA timezone; do not change shared session time_zone

lock_order: exact school executor grant shared when school-scoped
fence.revoke: same authority row exclusive update increments epoch; no ACK before commit; outstanding external effects reconciled
fence.missing_authority_row: DENY, never create implicitly during a write

frontend_scope.old_client: explicit compatibility window, server reauthorization on every write
frontend_scope.unknown_write_outcome: reconcile original operation ID before retry

trust_boundary: Reference Python tickets and JS inputs are trusted server inputs in tests; production cannot accept client-constructed epochs or tenant identities.

execution_scope.origin: derive from trusted request domain ownership and current authorized school; not a browser grant
execution_scope.intersection: school action requires global tenant fence, actor epoch, tenant-wide executor grant AND matching school executor grant
execution_scope.missing_scope_grant: DENY; never fall back to another school or tenant-only grant
execution_scope.result_replay: revalidate stored scope; changing school does not grant access to old receipt

account_identity.current_authority: ed_identity_account_current, explicit single current link per tenant and host account
account_identity.history: ed_identity_account_link preserves validity intervals; per-account serial transaction forbids overlapping intervals
account_identity.switch: lock account-current row, validate expected version and intervals, close old and append new link, CAS pointer, bump auth epoch and audit in same transaction
account_identity.unbound: NULL current pointer denies person-bound actions; never choose arbitrary history by LIMIT 1

nullable_class.observation: PERSON may have no class; CLASS requires class_id=subject_id
nullable_class.timeline: no-class entries exist for authorized non-class uses; class-scoped teacher query excludes them; parent reader must check current guardianship
